git/commit.name: Create Commits
git/commit.description: Create commits for recent changes. Multiple commits are allowed for logical grouping.

git/pull.name: Pull
git/pull.description: Run git pull and resolve issues if there's any output from git hook, and ask user how to resolve conflicts.

git/push.name: Push
git/push.description: Run git push and resolve issues if there's any output from git hook, and ask user how to resolve conflicts.

pr/create.name: Create Pull Request

pr/resolve.name: Resolve PR Reviews

worktree/sync.name: Sync Worktree

worktree/merge.name: Merge Worktree
worktree/merge.description: Merge a worktree branch into a target branch locally. Does not remove worktrees or branches.

worktree/cleanup.name: Cleanup Worktree
worktree/cleanup.description: Remove a git worktree and optionally delete its branch. Lists worktrees if no argument given.
